continuous_host_monitor.policy: Reject unrelated compilers, outside same-user CPU above 5%, or outside CPU excluding the recorded Falcon service above 5% for three consecutive two-second intervals. Record Falcon overhead and include it in timings.

storage.filesystem_scope: All Linux timing arms use the same scratch filesystem.

system_cpu.scope: Timed commands only. Windows are estimates from original log final-write mtime minus measured duration, not exact process start/stop timestamps. The union of intersecting two-second telemetry intervals is computed without double counting; every uncovered gap is reported. Separate monotonic interval and wall-clock timestamp reads, log-write latency, short-lived process exits, and telemetry resolution limit attribution. Same-UID means process ownership. CPU statistics do not change acceptance or select samples by performance.

summary: All 216 accepted workflow samples and 24 session replays passed the independent raw-result audit with matching paired test counts and no warnings.

Two compiler-overlap detections discarded two successful workflow commands. Both affected workflows restarted from fresh artifacts, including their preparation steps. The origin of the detected compiler processes was not established.

One workflow quiet-host preflight and one current-replay quiet-host preflight were rejected before any workloads started. Successful retries used the unchanged six-interval gate; the rejected evidence is retained.

A later compiler-overlap detection interrupted uv/Ohm during warmup before any timed steps in that cell. The original resume mechanism restarted it with fresh private and shared build directories and preserved three completed current replays and their logs unchanged. Interrupted artifacts and the preservation proof are retained.

An initial public release-mirror connection timeout occurred before benchmarks. Provisioning resumed using the exact verified GitHub release assets; no measurements depended on the failed preparation.

All 428 timed commands have host telemetry. Estimated windows retain every uncovered gap; maximum uncovered time is 1.663 seconds. Falcon remained enabled and its CPU overhead remains in the timings. No accepted attempt failed the frozen continuous host policy.

The uv sources leave development and test debug information unspecified, so the comparison includes Ohm 1.98.1-2 line-table defaults versus stock full debug information. Explicit settings and the frozen workload inputs match across toolchains.
